import Lean
import Proofs
open Lean Elab Command

run_cmd do
  let theorem_name := `Proofs.blank_spec
  match (← getEnv).find? theorem_name with
  | some (.thmInfo _) => pure ()
  | _ => throwError "Expected a theorem: Proofs.blank_spec"
  let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms theorem_name
  for ax in axioms do
    unless [``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound].contains ax do
      throwError "Unapproved axiom in Proofs.blank_spec: {ax}"
  liftIO <| IO.println "proofs.rs:checked:Proofs.blank_spec"

run_cmd do
  let theorem_name := `Proofs.is_ascii_digit_spec

  | some (.thmInfo _) => pure ()

  liftIO <| IO.println "proofs.rs:checked:Proofs.is_ascii_whitespace_spec"

run_cmd do
  let theorem_name := `Proofs.is_ascii_control_spec
